# e2b_lifecycle_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists E2B sandbox lifecycle webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_lifecycle_webhooks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) Lifecycle webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Lifecycle event names delivered to the webhook.
- `id` (String) Lifecycle webhook ID.
- `name` (String) Lifecycle webhook name.
- `team_id` (String) E2B team ID that owns the webhook.
- `url` (String) Webhook endpoint URL.
